english.title: Dishonestly fail to give notice of change affecting entitlement to reduction in council tax reduction scheme

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: council tax reduction schemes detection of fraud and enforcement wales regulations 2013

english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) following a change in circumstances which you knew would affect your entitlement to a reduction, or the amount of your reduction, under an authority's council tax reduction scheme, namely **(..SPECIFY THE CHANGE IN CIRCUMSTANCES..), dishonestly failed to give a prompt notification of that change in the manner required by the provision included in the authority's council tax reduction scheme by virtue of paragraph 7 of Schedule 13 to the Prescribed Requirements Regulations or by paragraph 113 of the Default Scheme
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 10(1) and (5) of the Council Tax Reduction Schemes (Detection of Fraud and Enforcement) (Wales) Regulations 2013.

english.notes: Notification of a change is prompt if, and only if, it is given within a period of 21 days beginning with the day on which the change occurs, or as soon as reasonably practicable after the change occurs, whichever is later.

other.penalty:
Summary: Six months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding level 5 on the standard scale
Indictment: Seven years imprisonment and / or a fine

Time Limit for Prosecutions:
None

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
